packageConsumer.method: npm pack and offline installation in a standalone temporary ESM app; browser examples compiled and bundled through installed public exports.
checks: Package file allowlist includes src/loanwords.js and rejects development artifacts
Manifest has only . and ./dom public exports and no runtime, peer or optional dependencies
Strict TypeScript Bundler React TSX compilation
esbuild input validation requires installed SahajLipi and rejects checkout src imports
Installed vanilla and React consumers pass all nine browser runs (three scenarios in each desktop engine)
packageConsumer.dependencies: No runtime, peer or optional package dependencies; React and tooling are development dependencies.
packageConsumer.tarballScope: Checksum is copied from the actual generated consumer manifest for this successful run. The temporary installed tarball was cleaned up by the build tool; later checkout documentation edits are not assigned this checksum.

rawReport.retention: Generated reports ignored; CI artifacts retained for 14 days.

nodeTests.evidenceScope: Successful root full-run summary; the browser JSON measures browser tests only.

scenarios: schoolma dropdown includes short-u and long-u readings; alternate can be selected
Adding a domain cue after an alternate displays the original Roman address; deleting the cue resumes the preferred default and undo restores the address
Backspace restores companyharu before reattaching mathi
English mode keeps later schoolma and mediasanga input literal
loanwordSuffixCoverage.adapterIdentity: src/dom.js and src/dom.d.ts hashes equal immutable baseline d3bb77f. Selected-reading reset after domain-cue deletion is inherited behavior exercised with the new word; no adapter change is claimed.

limitations: Headless desktop engines only; no installed application or physical device certification.
React 19.3.0 uncontrolled textarea recipe only; no controlled-value, form-library, SSR/hydration or all-framework support claim.
Existing clipboard, composition and native-input fallback tests inject events; no OS clipboard, real IME or mobile keyboard certification.
Counts describe selected software checks. The source-assisted language review is a development corpus; this run establishes neither independent human verification nor held-out linguistic accuracy.

Runtime/test/config/demo source hashes and actual package-consumer tarball checksum identify this run. Documentation updates may change a subsequent npm tarball without changing the measured runtime or tests.
